description: Dewan Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani sugar producer in the Yousuf Dewan group, with its registered office at Dewan Centre in Karachi and its factory at Jillaniabad, Budho Talpur, in district Thatta, Sindh. The company states its vision as becoming a leading player in the sugar sector, with a mission framed around responsible, straightforward conduct of the business and commitments to customers, employees, shareholders and the wider society. The group also runs a separate ethanol distillery business at Sujawal.
headOffice: Dewan Centre, 3-A, Lalazar Beach Luxury Hotel Road, Karachi 75350, Pakistan
